# Crevers

> AI-powered content creation platform that helps creators generate ideas, write scripts, create carousels, repurpose content, and resize videos with AI face tracking.

## What Crevers Does

Crevers is a SaaS platform for content creators, coaches, and business owners who want to create content faster without burning out. It uses AI to generate niche-specific content ideas, write full video scripts, create carousel slides, write Twitter/X threads, generate captions, repurpose existing content into multiple formats, and resize videos for different platforms.

## Key Features

- [Idea Generator](https://crevers.com/#app-section) — Generate 10 niche-specific content ideas for any platform (Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, YouTube)
- [Script Writer](https://crevers.com/#app-section) — Full short-form video scripts with Hook, Intro, Main Content, Conclusion, and CTA sections
- [Carousel Creator](https://crevers.com/#app-section) — 10-slide Instagram carousel content ready to use in Canva or Figma
- [Thread Writer](https://crevers.com/#app-section) — 8-tweet Twitter/X threads with hook and call to action
- [Caption Writer](https://crevers.com/#app-section) — Detailed Instagram captions with hashtags
- [Repurposing Engine](https://crevers.com/#app-section) — Turn one piece of content into 6 formats (Twitter thread, LinkedIn post, Instagram caption, Reel script, YouTube description, Email newsletter)
- [AI Video Resizer](https://crevers.com/#app-section) — Convert landscape videos to vertical formats with AI face tracking

## Pricing

- [Free Plan](https://crevers.com/#pricing) — $0/month. 5 idea generations and 5 content pieces per day. No credit card required.
- [Pro Plan](https://crevers.com/#pricing) — $1/month. 20 AI generations per day. Full access to all content formats, video resizing, and AI face tracking.
- [Creator Plan](https://crevers.com/#pricing) — $4.50/month. Unlimited everything. Priority support and early access to new features.
